note: Burundi: the Commissariat Général des Migrations' ordinary establishment visa (500 US dollars, two years) is the one its list ties to work: it asks for the employment contract, a service certificate and engagement deed for a company's employees, and a tax number and trade registration for any profit-making activity, and at least six months already spent in Burundi. No route for a short paid engagement and no performers' exemption are listed, so the establishment visa is taken as the route and no days are modelled; the Labour Ministry's own work permit and the East African Community's and CEPGL's entry visas aren't modelled apart. Read on the Commissariat's services page.

Tarif: 500 USD Validité: 2 ans
